context: This criteria evaluates correct usage of the library's BigNumber support and configuration API. It checks that the implementation properly configures the precision, uses the BigNumber number type (not standard floating-point), and returns a string result reflecting the configured precision.

checklist.name: Configures precision via config()
checklist.description: The implementation calls config() with the number type set to 'BigNumber' and the precision set to the given value before evaluation.

checklist.name: Uses BigNumber evaluation
checklist.description: The expression is evaluated in a context that produces BigNumber results, not standard JavaScript numbers, so that precision beyond 15-17 digits is preserved.

checklist.name: Returns string representation
checklist.description: The result is converted to a string (e.g. via .toString()) before being returned, not returned as a BigNumber object.

checklist.name: Precision reflected in result
checklist.description: Irrational results (e.g. 1/3, sqrt(2)) contain the correct number of significant digits as specified by the precision parameter.

checklist.name: Avoids floating-point errors
checklist.description: Expressions like 0.1 + 0.2 return exact results (0.3) rather than floating-point artifacts (0.30000000000000004).
